script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Romance
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. UPTOWN PENTHOUSE - NIGHT

Dramatic music swells as we pan through the opulent, dimly lit room. We come to rest on IVAN (35), a handsome, intense man with piercing blue eyes, clad in a tailored tuxedo. He's deep in thought, staring at a large model of a futuristic city.

IVAN
(whispering to himself)
One day, this will be mine.

Suddenly, the door bursts open, revealing NATALIE (32), a beautiful, fiery woman with fiery red hair and expressive green eyes. She's wearing a stunning red gown.

NATALIE
Ivan, you're late! We're already 15 minutes behind schedule.

IVAN
(looking up, surprised)
My apologies, Natalie. I couldn't help but be inspired by this vision.

NATALIE
(rolling her eyes)
Inspired? Or just lost in your own world?

IVAN
(smiling)
A little of both, perhaps.

They share a moment, their eyes locked.

NATALIE
Well, we have a gala to attend. Let's go.

INT. Uptown Gala - Night

IVAN and NATALIE make their way through the throngs of people, exchanging pleasantries and small talk.

NATALIE
(leaning in, whispering)
Ivan, I know how dedicated you are to your work. But don't you ever wonder if there's more to life than this?

IVAN
(looking pensive)
Of course, Natalie. But this is my dream, my ambition. And I won't let it go to waste.

NATALIE
(sighing)
I just want to make sure you're not neglecting other things in the process. Like us.

They share a lingering look as they continue to mingle.

INT. IVAN'S STUDIO - DAY

IVAN sits at his desk, surrounded by blueprints and models of his architectural designs. He looks up as NATALIE enters, wearing a simple yet elegant dress.

NATALIE
I brought you lunch.

IVAN
(gratefully)
Thank you, Natalie. This means a lot.

They eat in comfortable silence, occasionally sharing small talk.

NATALIE
(leaning against the desk)
Ivan, I know you're passionate about your work. But I worry about the toll it's taking on us.

IVAN
(looking into her eyes)
I value our relationship, Natalie. More than you know. But I can't give up on my dreams. Not now. Not when I'm so close.

NATALIE
(sighing)
I understand. But I don't want to be an afterthought, Ivan. I want to be a priority.

IVAN
(taking her hand)
You are, Natalie. I promise.

INT. ROOFTOP - NIGHT

IVAN and NATALIE stand on the rooftop of a building, gazing at the city below. The lights twinkle like stars.

IVAN
(whispering)
One day, we'll have our own city, Natalie. A city where we can live our dreams together.

NATALIE
(smiling)
I'll believe it when I see it, Ivan. But until then, I'll be here, supporting you every step of the way.

They share a passionate kiss as the music swells up again.

INT. Uptown Penthouse - Night

IVAN stands in the middle of the living room, looking at the model of the city. NATALIE enters, wearing a simple nightgown.

NATALIE
You're still up?

IVAN
(looking up, smiling)
Yes, my love. I can't help but be inspired.

NATALIE
(walking over to him)
Then inspire me, Ivan.

They share a tender moment as the camera pulls back, the city lights twinkling in the background.

FADE OUT.

THE END.
